snapshot.hauskaFactoryPrimary: P:/seat-worktrees/property/hauska-factory seat/property DIRTY salvage; not opened for writes

missionPremise: The console is honest and useless: the control key was rotated out of the public bundle on 2026-08-26 after it was compiled into JavaScript, so every screen renders UNAUTHENTICATED. The Factory store has been writing runs for a day. This card puts the key on a Vercel serverless proxy and puts an operator sign-in in front of every route. Sources: _dispatches/2026-08-27_f04-console-proxy_dispatch.md; _inbox/2026-08-27_f04_console_login_proxy_WDLL.md; OPS-19 A-001 and A-011.
completionPredicate: CP1 is design and worktree only. Hauska-map-factory dirty line-ending files restored. A clean hauska-factory-f04 worktree exists on seat/property-factory-control from origin/main. Design below is the build contract. No product code landed in this checkpoint.
scopeBasis: F-04 WDLL items 1-5. Item 6 exclusions: no new screens, no Factory store schema columns, no change to what the eleven screens mean (F-05/F-12), no Smart Site product session (P-86). Primary hauska-factory and writer/conform/publish/f10 trees are not this lane.

login.form: Smart Site OIDC providers (Google, Microsoft) reused as credentials; own session
login.unauthenticatedPage: sign-in buttons only; no counts, no screens data

controlApi.postChange: require X-Factory-Operator; refuse OPERATOR_REQUIRED on missing/sentinel (api, unknown, anonymous, system, operator); write actor onto control_actions.actor and runs.scope.operator
controlApi.getRuns: GET /runs last 20 (id, started_at, phase, target, status, counts, cost, refuse_code, operator) — read route, not a verb

verification.item1: vite build then grep dist for Bearer, factory-control, VITE_FACTORY
verification.item2: browser with no cookies: page is sign-in, every /api/proxy/* is 401
verification.item3: POST proxy no cookie 401; POST factory-control Bearer only OPERATOR_REQUIRED; POST factory-control forged header no Bearer 401
verification.item4: public GET factory-control /health and /counts 401; public GET console /api/proxy/counts 401
verification.item5: Vercel CLI deploy; factory-control redeployed by digest if item 3 ships

hauska-map-factory.action: restore four dirty files whose git diff was empty (line-ending noise); then build on this branch

falsifiers.cp1WrongIf: hauska-factory-f04 is created from the dirty seat/property tree rather than origin/main; or the console keeps VITE_FACTORY_CONTROL_API in the client
